headline_marked: Samsung charges $4.99/month for [[SmartThings API access]] from October
headline: Samsung charges $4.99/month for SmartThings API access from October
summary: Samsung to charge $4.99/month for individual developers. Advanced smart home users may also be affected.
details: Samsung will start charging $4.99 per month for individual developers to access its SmartThings API from October. This new pricing tier is aimed at non-commercial, individual developers.

The change may also impact advanced smart home users who directly access the SmartThings API for more flexible controls or use third-party tools that do the same. Some users of Home Assistant, an open-source smart home platform, will fall under the new 'personal plans'.
Samsung says the new pricing will allow it to invest in enterprise-grade features, including stability improvements, new integrations, and a refresh of its Developer Center hub.
caption:
Will your smart home be affected by Samsung's new $4.99/month API fee?

Samsung will start charging $4.99 per month for individual developers to access its SmartThings API from October. This new pricing tier is aimed at non-commercial, individual developers.

The change may also impact advanced smart home users who directly access the SmartThings API for more flexible controls or use third-party tools that do the same. Some users of Home Assistant, an open-source smart home platform, will fall under the new 'personal plans'.

Samsung says the new pricing will allow it to invest in enterprise-grade features, including stability improvements, new integrations, and a refresh of its Developer Center hub.
